governing_goal: Adopt the user-provided deep-task protocol as an actual UAOS execution contract for explicit depth requests and materially deep tasks, without creating a second cognition state machine. A deep task must be grounded in governing outcome, professional-practice gaps, primary/raw evidence, concrete methods/tools, unknown-signal search, competing alternatives and falsification, feasibility-bounded stretch targets, independent judge evidence, holdout/replay/production validation and explicit acceptance criteria before controlled finalization may claim completion.
starting_evidence: DELIBERATION_POLICY 2.0 already covered governing outcome, competing hypotheses, falsification, external research, independent verification and V&V, but no single deep-task admission required the full evidence bundle for an explicit depth request.
EVOLUTION_POLICY 2.0 carried raw evidence/professional methods/novelty/external judge only for governed evolution, not for arbitrary deep research, design or decision tasks.

CognitionCase validated typed evidence, causal alternatives, intervention tradeoffs and V&V for problem cases, but a non-problem deep task could finalize without proving the user-provided depth dimensions.
The assistant described the protocol as adopted before any repository authority, executable admission or runtime finalization gate had changed.
external_method_basis: NASA Systems Engineering Handbook: requirements-to-verification/validation traceability and planned verification methods.
NIST AI RMF/TEVV: documented test sets/metrics/tools, independent assessors, deployment-like evaluation and ongoing production monitoring.
SEI ATAM: business-driver/scenario/risk/tradeoff evaluation rather than architecture-by-familiarity.

architecture_candidates.reason: Would preserve a demonstrated gap between verbal deep-task intent and executable completion admission.
Would compete with the canonical cognition kernel and create a second workflow that can drift.
Deep tasks include research/design/decision work that may not trigger governed evolution.
Keeps the existing cognition kernel as owner, adds a reusable evidence admission and lets controlled finalization fail closed only when deep-task execution is required.

candidate_implementation: config/DEEP_TASK_EXECUTION_PROFILE.json defines the A-H evidence dimensions as a profile owned by DELIBERATION_POLICY, not as a second state machine.

src/uaos/kernel/deep_task.py adds DeepTaskCase and require_deep_task_admission for governing outcome, external professional-practice evidence, raw material, methods/tools, unknown discovery, alternatives/falsification, independent judge, holdout/replay/production validation, acceptance criteria and feasibility-bounded stretch targets.

src/uaos/runtime/finalization.py adds deep_task_required/deep_task_case and fail-closes controlled finalization when required evidence is missing; problem deep tasks must remain outcome/evidence-consistent with CognitionCase.
DELIBERATION_POLICY candidate 2.1.0 remains the sole cognition-stage owner and activates the profile for explicit deeper-not-larger requests or qualified material high-uncertainty tasks.
COMMON_CAPABILITIES keeps contract 1.7.0 and inherits the profile through adaptive_deliberation_and_parent_guidance without copying a new cognition algorithm.
SYSTEM_MAP 2.1, ENTRYPOINT candidate 2.8.0, AGENTS instructions and CURRENT_SYSTEM candidate 2.8.0 point to the same profile/admission/finalization surfaces.
tests/kernel/test_deep_task.py, tests/runtime/test_deep_task_finalization.py and tests/kernel/test_deep_task_policy_contract.py cover negative and positive admission paths.

ci_history.repair: Updated CURRENT_SYSTEM to candidate UAOS 2.8.0, preserved the existing other-policies single-cognition invariant, and made the no-second-cognition-state-machine profile rule explicit.
